snippet.title: Blue Ridge Hunting  - Official Trailer | Women-Led Games: The Game Awards Edition 2025
snippet.description: Get a closer look at Blue Ridge Hunting in this latest trailer for the upcoming co-op horror game that invites players to explore the Appalachian Mountains, home to some of America’s most iconic folklore and cryptid legends. Based on real sightings and stories from the region, investigators will use a range of tools and items to collect evidence, track creatures, and document their findings. Successful hunts earn money that can be used to purchase better gear—but remember, the woods are alive. Creatures react to proximity voice chat and radio communication, so coordination is vital… and dangerous.
